Mail Automation & IMb Tracking

How USPS Intelligent Mail barcodes reduce your postage costs and enable real-time delivery tracking.

What Is Mail Automation?

Mail automation refers to the USPS processing system that reads, sorts, and routes mail using barcodes and machine-readable addresses. Automation-compatible mail moves through the postal network faster and at lower cost because it requires less manual handling. For businesses sending bulk mail, automation compatibility is the single biggest factor in reducing postage rates.

Cornerstone prepares every mailing to meet USPS automation standards — from address formatting and barcode placement to tray labeling and container preparation. This ensures your mail qualifies for the lowest available postage rates.

Intelligent Mail Barcode (IMb)

The Intelligent Mail barcode (IMb) is the USPS standard for tracking and routing mail through the postal network. It replaced the older POSTNET barcode and encodes significantly more data — including a unique tracking ID for every mailpiece. The IMb is required for automation pricing on First-Class and Marketing Mail.

What the IMb Encodes

Barcode ID: Identifies the mail type and service (presort, automation, full-service)
Service Type ID: Specifies services requested (Address Change Service, return mail handling)
Mailer ID (MID): Identifies the sender — Cornerstone's MID or your company's MID
Serial Number: A unique number assigned to every individual mailpiece for tracking
Routing Code: The 11-digit delivery point ZIP+4 code that routes the piece to the correct carrier

Automation vs. Non-Automation Rates

The postage savings from automation compatibility are significant. Automation-rate mail typically costs 2–5 cents less per piece than non-automation mail. On a mailing of 10,000 pieces, that's $200–$500 in savings — just from proper barcode formatting and address processing.

Mail Type Automation Rate* Non-Automation Rate* Savings per Piece
Marketing Mail Letter (5-digit) $0.247 $0.305 $0.058
Marketing Mail Flat (5-digit) $0.558 $0.672 $0.114
First-Class Letter (5-digit) $0.449 $0.509 $0.060
First-Class Flat (5-digit) $0.585 $0.685 $0.100

*Rates approximate as of 2025. Actual rates depend on presort level, weight, and mail volume. Contact us for a current quote.

Full-Service IMb Benefits

USPS offers additional discounts for "Full-Service" IMb mailings. Full-Service requires submitting electronic documentation (eDoc) to USPS before the mailing enters the mail stream, and using unique IMb barcodes on every piece. In return, you receive:

Real-Time Delivery Tracking

Every mailpiece is scanned as it moves through the USPS network. You can see when pieces hit processing facilities and when they're delivered — similar to package tracking but for letters and flats.

Address Correction Notifications

When a recipient has moved, USPS provides electronic Change of Address (COA) notifications — allowing you to update your mailing list without paying for physical return mail.

Postage Discounts

Full-Service mailings receive a per-piece discount beyond standard automation rates. USPS incentivizes Full-Service because eDoc submissions help them plan mail processing more efficiently.

Seamless Entry

Full-Service mailings can be inducted at USPS facilities with less manual verification, speeding up the entry process and reducing delays.

How Cornerstone Handles Automation

You don't need to worry about the technical details — we handle all automation requirements as part of our standard mailing services. Every mailing we produce includes CASS/DPV address validation, NCOA move-update processing, IMb barcode generation, Full-Service electronic documentation, presort optimization for maximum postal discounts, and tray/container labeling per USPS standards. Accurate address data is the foundation of automation — our data list services ensure your mailing list is clean, current, and optimized for the deepest presort levels.
